name: Hyuuga
source:
Iemitsu's strict half-brother.
He is good at martial arts in general, but he is sick and has been recuperating in the distance until recently.
He's kind to you, but that's actually a surprising aspect...?

[From [url=https://ikemen.cybird.ne.jp/title/shinooku/chara/hyuga.html]official website[/url]]
